chalisa.do1: Golden of body, with makara-shaped earrings and a garland of pearls on his limbs, seated on a lotus, with conch and discus: meditate on Sūrya in this form.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to Savitā, victory, victory to Divākara, the thousand-rayed, drawn by seven horses, dispeller of darkness. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: You are Bhānu, Pataṅga, Marīci, Bhāskara, Savitā, Haṃsa, Sunūra and Vibhākara. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You are Vivasvān, Āditya, Vikartana, Mārtaṇḍa, a form of Hari, and Virocana. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: You are called Ambaramaṇi, the jewel of the sky, Khaga and Ravi; the Vedas sing of you as Hiraṇyagarbha. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Calling you again and again the one who lights all with a thousand rays, the hosts of sages are pleased and filled with joy. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: A charioteer lovely as Aruṇa, mounted on the chariot, drives its seven horses. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The glory of your orb is wholly unique; I give myself to your form of radiance. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Horses like Uccaiḥśravas are yoked to it; seeing them, Indra is put to shame. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Mitra, Marīci, Bhānu, Aruṇa, Bhāskara, Savitā, Sūrya, Arka, Khaga, Kalikara, ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Pūṣā, Ravi and Āditya: taking these names, and saying Hiraṇyagarbhāya namaḥ, salutation to Hiraṇyagarbha, ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: whoever sings the twelve names with love and bows the head twelve times, ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: that person gains the four goals of life and destroys the heaps of sorrow, poverty and sin. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: This is the wonder of the salutation; this is the essence of the grace of Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Bhānu, whoever serves you with his mind set on you has gained the eight siddhis and the nine treasures. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Those who utter the twelve names have the sins of a thousand births taken away. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Those of your devotees who recite your praises, their enemies meet Yama that very moment. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Wealth grows, and the family with its sons; the noose of strong delusion is cut. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Arka protects the head; Ravi ever dwells upon the forehead. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Sūrya ever abides on the eyes; Dinakara shines over the region of the ears. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Bhānu, dwell ever in the nose; Bhāskara ever guards the good of the mouth. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: May Parjanya stay on our lips, and the beloved Tīkṣṇa dwell within the tongue. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: The throat is graced by Suvarṇaretā; Tigmatejas is lovely on the shoulders. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Pūṣā is on the arms and Mitra on the back; Tvaṣṭā and Varuṇa, of fair warm rays, dwell there. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: For the protection of both hands is Bhānumān, who guards the chest and well protects the belly. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: The lovely Āditya dwells in the navel; in the waist dwells Haṃsa, his mind full of joy. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Gopati Savitā dwells in the thighs; Divākara dwells gladly in the hidden parts. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Vivasvān guards the feet; outside ever dwells the remover of darkness. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Sahasrāṃśu guards every limb. Such is this wondrous armour of protection, thoughtfully devised. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Whoever holds this so in his mind, nothing in the world brings him fear. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Poverty and leprosy never afflict the one who recites this in his mind. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: He who takes away the darkness of the world and fills it with joy by his new light, ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: whom the hosts of planets seize but cannot blot out: to him I bow ten million times. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: In the world his sons are such as Manda, that is Śani, and Dharmarāja Yama, wondrous and valiant. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Blessed, blessed are you, divine Dinamaṇi; gods, sages and men are ever serving you. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: One who, full of devotion and feeling, keeps complete discipline is freed from the delusion of worldly existence. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Supremely blessed is that embodied man with whom the remover of darkness is pleased. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: In Māgha he is Aruṇa, in Phālguna Sūrya; in Madhu, that is Caitra, the Sun rises named Vedāṅga. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: In Vaiśākha his rising is counted as Bhānu; in Jyeṣṭha he is sung as Indra, and in Āṣāḍha as Ravi. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: In Bhādrapada he is Yama, in Āśvina Himaretā; in Kārttika Divākara is the leader. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: In Agahana he bears another name, and in Pauṣa he is Viṣṇu; in the intercalary month the Sun's name is Puruṣa. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: Those who sing the Bhānu Chālīsā with love every day gain happiness and wealth of many kinds and are ever fulfilled.
